name: Lindsay Ravensun
summary: Lindsay Ravensun appears as a plainspoken Forsaken operative assisting Horde forces in the blighted ruins of Andorhal. Beneath her unassuming presence lies a calculated disguise, secretly watching the unfolding campaign across the Western Plaguelands.

sections.title: A Scout in the Ruins
sections.body: Amid the brutal war for control of Andorhal, Lindsay Ravensun operates as a liaison and advisor among the Forsaken ranks. Stationed near the front lines, she directs recruits into key tactical maneuvers against the lingering Scourge and Alliance contingents. To the average foot soldier, she seems to be little more than a competent military officer carrying out standard operations in the Plaguelands.

sections.title: The Banshee Queen's Shadow
sections.body: In truth, Lindsay Ravensun is no ordinary operative. The persona is a clandestine alias adopted by Sylvanas Windrunner herself to oversee the front lines in disguise. Unwilling to leave the crucial territory of Lordaeron entirely in the hands of subordinates, the Banshee Queen slips into the ranks incognito, observing the loyalty and tactical resolve of her commanders firsthand before casting aside her mantle to seize direct command.

faq.answer: To ordinary eyes, Lindsay Ravensun is a Forsaken officer providing military tasks and scouting reports in Andorhal. In reality, she is an undercover disguise assumed by Lady Sylvanas Windrunner to survey the front lines in person.

faq.q: Why does Sylvanas disguise herself as Lindsay?
faq.answer: Sylvanas adopts the identity to inspect military readiness firsthand, test the mettle of her commanders, and intervene directly without the widespread alarm or strategic posturing that her public presence as the Banshee Queen would inevitably cause.

faq.q: Where can Lindsay Ravensun be encountered?
faq.answer: She can be found in the Western Plaguelands, primarily stationed near Forsaken encampments in and around the ruins of Andorhal.

faq.q: Are there clues to her real identity before the reveal?
faq.answer: Yes. Beyond her unusually commanding knowledge and sharp remarks about the Dark Lady watching, the name 'Lindsay Ravensun' is a near-anagram of 'Sylvanas Windrunner'.

angles.text: Serving under Lindsay Ravensun means unwittingly executing the personal orders of your Banshee Queen, testing whether your loyalty to the Forsaken holds even when her presence is masked.
Horde soldiers fighting in Andorhal might see her as just another cold Undercity commander, unaware of how closely the faction's leadership monitors the battle for Lordaeron's contested ruins.
